instruction: Turn on Ubuntu's automatic screen blank feature to save power when idle.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling screen blank after idle time (5 minutes = 300 seconds). The config sets idle-delay to 0 (disabled), and the evaluator checks that the agent set it to 300 (5 minutes). Uses GNOME session schema with uint32 type.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the idle-delay setting using 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay' command
Metric function 'exact_match' appropriately compares the retrieved setting value with expected value
Expected value 'uint32 300\n' matches the exact output format returned by gsettings command (including type prefix and newline)
Evaluator fully covers the single requirement: verify that screen blank is enabled with 5-minute (300 second) idle delay
Data flow is correct: getter retrieves current setting -> exact_match compares -> expected value is semantically correct for the task
